rs-6jty.title: Language: Ђ, Ћ in Cyrillic text
rs-6jty.summary: Serbian uses both Cyrillic and Latin script. The letters Ђ and Ћ are only Serbian; Љ, Њ and Џ are shared with Macedonian.

rs-8vGG.title: Google car: white car, short antenna
rs-8vGG.summary: A white Google car with a short antenna shows up around Novi Sad, Belgrade, Niš and the motorway linking them. The car is not always visible.

rs-C8Jw.title: Language: Latin letters Č Ć Đ Š Ž
rs-C8Jw.summary: Latin-script Serbian uses Č, Ć, Đ, Š and Ž. Croatian and Montenegrin use all of these letters too.

rs-LpbY.title: Google car: no antenna in Gen 3
rs-LpbY.summary: Most of the older Gen 3 coverage was shot by a car with no antenna. Almost all neighbouring central and eastern European countries have an antenna in Gen 3, except North Macedonia.

rs-QMqw.title: Landscape: rolling hills, bigger further south
rs-QMqw.summary: In the south, a similar rolling landscape along a river basin, but with larger hills and mountains.

rs-RnNO.title: Landscape: lush green mountains
rs-RnNO.summary: In the south and southeast, along the Bulgarian and Kosovo borders, the land is lush, green and mountainous.

differs.how: Kosovo looks similar next door, so use borders and signs

rs-SDu4.title: Coverage: four Google car colours
rs-SDu4.summary: Four different car colours were used here, each in different areas, so car colour can point to a part of the country.

rs-V8kh.title: Google car: low-mounted camera, big round blur
rs-V8kh.summary: A low-mounted Gen 4 camera with a big round blur, a small bump at the front and a short antenna or black blur at the back. The blur can be see-through, so it is easy to miss. Most Balkan countries have it.

rs-VSVy.title: Guardrail: B-profile (double wave)
rs-VSVy.summary: Only the B-profile guardrail is used here, the common double-wave shape. North Macedonia does not use it.

differs.how: North Macedonia uses other guardrail profiles

rs-VetX.title: Landscape: pancake flat plains in the north
rs-VetX.summary: In the far north up to the capital, the land is extremely flat with no hills, apart from one small ridge. Hillier in the centre and south; the highest mountains are in the southwest and southeast.

rs-WCh2.title: Coverage: autumn Gen 3 photos
rs-WCh2.summary: Gen 3 coverage taken in autumn appears south of Čačak and in a small area around Valjevo.

rs-WqwF.title: Chevron: black arrow on white
rs-WqwF.summary: Curve signs with a black arrow on a white background. Slovenia, Montenegro and North Macedonia use the same look.

rs-ajNO.title: Language: Serbian and Hungarian together
rs-ajNO.summary: In the far north, where many Hungarians live, signs show Serbian next to Hungarian.

rs-eWgo.title: Plate: white with blue strip on left
rs-eWgo.summary: White plates with a blue strip on the left. Tractors and farm vehicles have green plates. Croatian and North Macedonian plates usually have no blue strip.

differs.how: Croatian plates usually lack the blue strip
North Macedonian plates usually lack the blue strip

rs-enVL.title: Landscape: gentle rolling hills
rs-enVL.summary: In the centre-north, slightly rolling hills.

rs-kehq.title: Landscape: lone low ridge in flat land
rs-kehq.summary: A slight ridge rising from otherwise flat land, in a national park southwest of Novi Sad.

rs-lm-3003.title: Pedestrian sign: no hat, rounded figure
rs-lm-3003.summary: Two types: a horizontal zebra with a hatless, rounded figure, or five zebra stripes with a rounded figure, no belt and a white or silver border. The second type is shared with Slovenia.

differs.how: Austria's figure is more detailed, has a hat

rs-lm-476093.title: Pole: metal ladder or mesh pole in town
rs-lm-476093.summary: Metal poles shaped like a ladder or with a mesh pattern are common in small towns. A random metal pole inside a town is likely here.

rs-lm-740395.title: Sign: street sign with flag-coloured shield
rs-lm-740395.summary: Street signs in the capital show Cyrillic and Latin text and a shield on the left in the national flag colours.

rs-mTBk.title: Coverage: Gen 3 in north, centre and southeast
rs-mTBk.summary: Older Gen 3 coverage is mostly in the north, around the capital and in the southeast. Kosovo has no Gen 3 at all.

rs-qGEx.title: Bollard: flat post, reflector off-centre
rs-qGEx.summary: Several designs exist, but most are flat posts with the reflector off to one side rather than in the middle. Off-centre reflector is the key.

differs.how: Austrian reflector sits in the centre
Slovenian reflector sits in the centre

rs-w6kX.title: Phone numbers: 2-digit area code, 1 to 3
rs-w6kX.summary: Area codes have 2 digits and the first digit is 1, 2 or 3. 2 is the north, 1 is the centre and east, 3 is the southwest.

rs-yQCt.title: Landscape: mountains rising from flat land
rs-yQCt.summary: Near the Romanian border, a distinct mountain range rises out of flat land, with vineyards to its south and a castle on top.
